title: Local Logarithmic Cartier Transform
summary: This article is the first of three articles whose goal is to generalize the Cartier transform of Ogus and Vologodsky to the logarithmic setting. In this article, we generalize a local version, due to Shiho, of the Cartier transform to log smooth schemes. More precisely, let $k$ be a perfect field of positive characteristic and equip $\operatorname{Spec}k$ with the trivial logarithmic structure.
